Porter's Immortal Cultivation: I Have Level 5 Full Inscriptions

Chapter 266 Road

chevron_leftPrev Nextchevron_right nights_stay

Shi Xuangu was extremely excited after receiving her name. She ran around the field and finally jumped into Yang Silang's arms, bouncing a few times.

With her current cultivation level, once she solidifies her body, she truly resembles a young girl.

Her weight was similar to that of a typical three- or four-year-old girl, only a little lighter, and she cast a shadow on the ground when illuminated by candlelight.

Raise your palm, the skin on top The tiny fingerprints are clearly visible on the skin. You can even see the veins and blood vessels below.

Although she is a spirit, the flesh beneath her skin is evolved from yin and yang energies, and feels exactly like a real person.

When one reaches this level of cultivation, the soul and body become like a real person, hence the name "Rebirth Realm," where "rebirth" refers to the physical body.

According to records, there was once a female Taoist priest who married a man in her soul form and shared a bed with him for more than ten years, yet the man never discovered that she was not a real person of flesh and blood.

Of course, this is not Shi Xuangu's true cultivation level. It is her innate ability to use the power of the Flying Thunder Stone to solidify her body with lightning.

Shi Xuangu jumped into Yang Silang's arms, and a crackling sound of electricity immediately emanated from her body. She used her magic weapon as a carrier, and the power she gathered was mainly the thunderous power from the Flying Thunder Stone.

Fortunately, Yang Silang, as the owner of the Flying Thunder Stone, will not be harmed.

After Shi Xuangu finished frolicking, she looked at the roof with a wronged expression.

"Mother, why don't you come down and play with me?"

"By the way, I have a name called Shi Xuangu. Mother, why don't you give yourself a name too?"

"But it has to take my surname, and it has to be Shi."

Yang Silang was speechless.

What a mischievous child, turning the world upside down!

Grandma Tianjing gave an awkward smile.

"Alright, alright, Mother will take your surname."

"Young friend, why don't you help me choose a name?"

Yang Silang thought for a moment and then slowly said.

"Grandma Tianjing, why don't you just call yourself Shi Ji? It's elegant, appropriate, simple, and easy to remember."

Grandma Tianjing read it twice and then smiled.

"Okay, Grandma will have a name from now on."

She then turned to explain to Shi Xuangu.

"My dear, it's not that Mommy doesn't want to go down and play with you."

"It's just that Mother's physical form isn't fully formed yet... Look..."

A demonic aura erupted from the round stone on the roof, landing and transforming into a middle-aged man. .

She was around thirty years old, plump and curvy, with exaggerated curves, but not bloated.

She wore a plain-colored palace dress, her hair was loose and flowing down her back, not tied up in a bun, and she didn't wear any headdress.

Looking only at the upper body, it's clearly a very mature look. Her hair was jet black, her skin was fair with a rosy glow, and her eyes sparkled with tears.

However, from the waist down, his buttocks and legs glowed with white light, and he seemed like a reflection in water, without any sense of solid flesh and blood.

It turns out that Granny Tianjing has only condensed half of her body so far, and her lower body has not yet materialized.

She looked as if she was floating in the air, which was very strange. No wonder she didn't want to show herself.

Grandma looked embarrassed.

It's quite embarrassing that one's centuries-old mother isn't as powerful as one's daughter, who's only a little over six months old.

It has lived a long time, but there is not enough spirit stone supply on a daily basis. It is also confined in this tower and most of its demonic power is used for patrolling and recording.

Therefore, although he is about the same age as She Nu, his cultivation level is far lower. According to the classification of human cultivators, he is still trying to break through to the Body Condensation Realm.

With the help of the Flying Thunder Stone, Shi Xuangu has already firmly established herself in the next major realm below the Body Condensation Realm, the Rebirth Realm.

"Mother..." Shi Xuangu didn't care about anything else and ran happily towards Granny Tianjing.

As a result, she had just gotten close to Grandma Tianjing.

Grandma's eyes showed fear, and the light emanating from her body became scattered and uncertain.

The power of thunder can suppress almost all evil spirits and yin souls. Even Granny Tianjing's soul body cannot withstand the approach of the power of thunder.

With quick eyes and hands, Yang Silang grabbed Shi Xuangu by the neck and pulled her back.

"Don't go over there, are you trying to murder your own mother?"

Shi Xuangu pursed her lips, and the little girl became completely depressed.

"I can't hug you, I can't kiss you, how boring."

Yang Silang patted her head, flipped his hand and stuffed a small bag of five-colored stones into her hand, and gave her two spirit stones as well.

"Go play by yourself, I need to talk to your mother."

Shi Xuangu grabbed the spirit stones and started munching on them like she was eating a steamed bun.

She was at the age where she loved to eat, and quickly forgot about the unpleasantness, obediently sitting to the side with the stone in her arms and starting to eat.

Grandma Tianjing looked at her with loving eyes, not getting enough of her gaze, and stared at her for a long time before turning her head away.

"Fellow Daoist, my daughter is doing very well under your care. I knew I hadn't misjudged you. Thank you so much."

"Grandma, there's no need for thanks between us. What are your plans for the future? Will you continue to guard this tower?"

Shi Ji shook her head.

"Once we Crystal Demons can cultivate to the Body Condensation Realm, we will awaken another divine ability called Split."

"It means completely separating a clone, possessing its own complete memories and part of its cultivation. Bookmark this page and continue reading 'The Porter's Immortal Cultivation: I Have Level 5 Full Inscriptions' anytime, anywhere."

"Of course, almost no other demon can cultivate to this level among the stone demons that guard the tower, and they all reach the end of their lifespan and depart."

"I was lucky enough to meet a fellow Daoist, and somehow faked my death, which allowed me to be reborn and break through my cultivation level."

"I have guarded the pagoda for three hundred years, and I have done right by the Great Shun Dynasty. I am tired of staying in this place."

"Also, it's out of respect for you. I've changed, and I can't hide it from Master Fu."

"The old master did a good deed by keeping it a secret from his superiors."

Yang Silang nodded and readily agreed.

If it were any other Grandmaster of the Tower, it would be hard to say. Given his relationship with Fu Liunian, if he were to act discreetly, even if Fu Liunian discovered it, he probably wouldn't stop him.

The two chatted for a while longer, and seeing that it was getting late, Yang Silang left with Shi Xuangu.

The mother and daughter were naturally reluctant to part.

Yang Silang promised to bring Shi Xuangu into the tower in a few days.

He won't come as often as before; after all, he has already become a grandmaster.

Most of the boxing techniques in the Martial Arts Pagoda were meaningless to him.

Even if there are a few top-tier Grandmaster-level Golden Marrow techniques.

However, he has the Great Five Elements Strength and Great Five Elements Fist to practice, as well as the Turtle Breathing Technique of the same level, the Killing Spear, and the higher-level auxiliary cultivation technique Thunder Essence Golden Body.

That's more than enough. There's absolutely no need to cultivate any other techniques, not even grandmaster-level ones.

Now that everyone knows he has passed the imperial examination and become a master, his frequent visits to the tower are bound to arouse suspicion.

You can't exactly say that you're exchanging skills with Fu Liunian, the famous martial arts fanatic who secludes himself every day, can you?

At night, I returned to the courtyard.

Yang Silang sat on the bed, looking up at the bright moon shining down in the sky, filled with endless emotion.

At the age of 16, he awakened his innate wisdom and, as a refugee, led his fifth sister to seek refuge with his eldest sister.

As a result, they were kicked out by Grandma Yao, and it was only after the eldest sister took out the money she had saved that they were finally able to settle down.

Even if you become a porter in Sanshui, you won't have a peaceful life.

After awakening his system, he practiced the Three-Legged Stance to strengthen his body. Finally, with the help of inscriptions and supernatural powers, he saved Commander Ruan on the battlefield, thus embarking on the path of martial arts.

Upon entering the martial arts hall, he recognized the dragon's eye and was taught the Taizu Long Fist. At the age of 17, he mastered the Copper Skin Martial Arts and passed the martial arts examination to become a Martial Arts Scholar.

After bidding farewell to Instructor Long, he acquired the Toad Strength and Five-in-One Fist. The following year, he went to Gongzhou Prefecture, the provincial capital, and became an Iron-Bone Martial Arts Master. At the age of 18, he passed the imperial examination for martial arts.

Then he began to practice the Five Qi Strength and the Great Five Combination Fist, and in that year, amidst the chorus of frogs in his hometown, he broke through to become the Steel-Dirty Grand Martial Master.

He then turned to the Five Elements Strength and Five Elements Fist, spending almost a year and a half in arduous training. On New Year's Eve, on a desolate mountain outside his hometown, he became a grandmaster, on the last day of his 19th year.

In the same year, the seventy-second year of Yongchang, he went to the capital to take the imperial examination and was awarded the title of Jinshi (a successful candidate in the highest imperial examinations).

From age 16 to 20, excluding the initial foundational training period, my formal martial arts training progressed from a state of physical strength and resilience to one that progressed almost annually.

Meanwhile, Wang Daniu, who was cultivating alongside him, was still striving to break through to the Iron Bone Martial Master realm.

This shows how quickly he cultivated himself.

Of course, we should never forget those who dug the well when we drink the water; Yang Silang is truly grateful to the Inscription System.

A thought struck him, and a screen of light appeared before his eyes.

Yang Silang

Lifespan (basic): 20/200.

Force (Basic): 500

[Skill 1: Great Five Elements Strength, practiced five times a day, 100/2000.]

[Skill 2: Five daily training sessions of the Great Five Elements Fist, 60/2000.]

[Skill 3: Killing Spear (Missing), 150/2000.]

[Skill 4: Turtle Breathing Technique, practiced continuously while sitting, lying down, or walking, 200/2000 hours daily.]

[Skill 5: Thunder Element Forging Golden Body Technique, 10/4000.]

In terms of lifespan, he is only one-tenth of his lifespan, two hundred years old. Even those martial saints who specialize in wood-based techniques might not live as long as him.

After all, martial artists cultivate their bodies but not their lives. Their bodies are incredibly powerful, but their lifespans are not significantly extended. Perhaps this is a limitation imposed by the Heavenly Dao of this world.

The progress of the Great Five Elements Force is faster than that of the Great Five Elements Fist. Although they were cultivated at roughly the same time, it is probably because the True Meaning of Metal was only comprehended two months ago, so the Great Five Elements Fist is slower.

As for the Killing Spear changing from crippled to incomplete, it's because I only comprehended the Golden Fist Intent, and I haven't yet mastered its core killing intent.

Fortunately, his training time was halved.

The Turtle Breathing Technique is actually the fastest progressing of all techniques, because it is the only one that is unaffected by the spirit-suppressing array in the capital.

As an auxiliary technique, it is the key to truly reversing one's inherent constitution.

While Yin-Yang Rebirth Tea can also raise a person's potential, it pales in comparison to the miraculous effects of Turtle Breathing Exercise.

There is also the Thunder Essence Forging Golden Body Technique, which, strictly speaking, is a semi-Martial Saint auxiliary cultivation technique.

It is not considered a martial saint's technique because this technique does not require the divine will of a martial saint.

It specializes in secondary cultivation, using lightning to temper the body and soul, greatly increasing the speed of cultivating the main cultivation method.

Yang Silang had seen the contents of the jade tablet on the way. This technique, when practiced to its final stage, could even make the body as hard as glass and as solid as diamond, no less than specialized body-refining hard qigong techniques.

A high-level cultivation technique that can accelerate cultivation and greatly increase one's own defense is extremely rare and precious.

Of course, the conditions for its cultivation are also very demanding, namely, it requires drawing lightning into the body, and the lightning must be of the highest controllable quality.

Once a true immortal's natal magic weapon, the Flying Thunder Stone, now fused and reshaped by Shi Xuan Gu, perfectly meets all the requirements.

Two thousand days is roughly five and a half years, but with the Yellow Jade Fruit and the Thunder Essence Golden Body Technique, I am confident that I can reduce the time to half or even less.

"Two years..." Yang Silang set himself a small goal, "To strive to break through and become a Grandmaster of Golden Marrow within two years!"
